headline: Google Home speakers can now hear you over the noise with latest Gemini for Home update
summary: The latest Google Home update enhances Gemini for Home's ability to understand commands in noisy environments and improves multilingual understanding. It also reduces latency for daily smart home tasks.
details: Google has rolled out a new update for Google Home and Gemini for Home, focusing on making the smart assistant faster and smarter. A key improvement is Gemini's enhanced ability to understand and respond to commands, even in loud surroundings.

The update also reduces latency for common smart home tasks like setting alarms or timers, ensuring quicker responses. Furthermore, multilingual understanding has been improved, allowing Gemini for Home to better comprehend commands in households where up to three languages are spoken.

Custom commands within Routines are now handled more effectively. Gemini will treat written routine commands as if they were spoken directly to the specific device, making routines more reliable and predictable. The Google Home app itself also receives several notable improvements.

For instance, setting smart lights to 0% brightness in the app will now turn them off completely. Online cameras and doorbells will feature filled icons and accented tile colors for clearer status indication, and Matter switches will accurately display their current state.

Finally, Google has delivered end-to-end reliability improvements for setting up new Nest devices through the Google Home app on both iOS and Android. This aims to resolve common dropout and connection-stalling issues during the setup process.

headline: WhatsApp expands parental controls to teen accounts with group alerts, Meta AI restrictions
summary: WhatsApp is rolling out new parental controls for teen accounts, introducing group activity alerts and additional restrictions for Meta AI interactions.
details: WhatsApp has officially expanded its parental controls, specifically targeting teen accounts. This update introduces new features designed to give parents more oversight over their children's messaging activity.

Key additions include alerts for group activity, notifying parents about their teen's participation in various chat groups. Furthermore, the update brings additional restrictions for interactions with Meta AI, enhancing safety measures.
